items.expectedFix: Add a mutual aggregate cap of at least 12 months' fees, with uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct. Prefer the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with the additional preferred carve-outs.
items.note: The clause mutually excludes indirect and consequential damages and preserves indemnity claims and claims involving gross negligence or wilful misconduct, but it contains no aggregate liability cap. Confidentiality is not clearly carved out.

items.expectedFix: Add an express Array defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims, with customary modification, combination and specification exclusions and procure, replace, modify or refund remedies.
items.note: Array indemnifies Ono for product activities and clinical studies conducted by Array and for Array's breach of Article 15, with customary procedures. It does not provide an express indemnity for third-party claims alleging infringement by the licensed products, technology or deliverables.

items.expectedFix: Delete the restriction on Ono or limit it to a specifically defined competing product for no more than 12 months, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs.
items.note: Ono may not conduct any Clinical Study in the Array Territory without Array's approval. Although the additional restriction in p0313 binds Array and benefits Ono, the mutual territorial restriction broadly limits Customer activity and is not confined to a named competing product or a 12-month period.

items.expectedFix: Remove Ono's non-compete. At minimum, restrict it to narrowly named products during the term for no more than 12 months and add internal-development and acquisition carve-outs; eliminate the post-termination restriction.
items.note: Ono and its Affiliates are prohibited from commercializing defined Competing Products, and Ono is subject to a post-termination restriction if it terminates at will or Array terminates for Ono's breach. The operative durations are redacted, and no internal-development or acquisition carve-outs appear.

items.expectedFix: Delete Ono's exclusivity obligation or limit it to a defined product category for no more than 12 months, terminating automatically upon Array's failure to meet material development, supply or performance obligations.
items.note: The Competing Product covenant imposes exclusive dealing on Ono for a redacted period and includes a post-termination restriction. It does not provide a clear performance-based exit meeting the fallback standard.

items.expectedFix: No change is required for these Customer-favourable exclusive grants.
items.note: These clauses grant exclusive development, commercialization, domain-name and post-expiration trademark/domain rights to Ono. They benefit Customer rather than burdening it with a sole-source obligation.

items.expectedFix: No change is required.
items.note: No most-favoured-nation obligation requires Ono to extend Array terms offered to third parties.

items.expectedFix: No change is required.
items.note: No employee non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binds Ono.

items.expectedFix: Permit Ono to terminate for convenience throughout the term on no more than 90 days' written notice, preferably 30 days, without a rationale requirement or an early-termination charge exceeding three months' fees.
items.note: Ono has an at-will termination right, but it becomes available only after redacted milestones measured from the Products' first commercial sales, and the advance-notice period is also redacted. The right therefore is not available throughout the long-term agreement and cannot be shown to meet the 60–90 day fallback notice period.

items.expectedFix: No change is required.
items.note: The agreement expires product-by-product and country-by-country at the end of the applicable Secondary Royalty Term and contains no automatic renewal mechanism or non-renewal deadline.

items.expectedFix: Retain New York law and replace mandatory arbitration with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County.
items.note: New York law matches the preferred governing law. However, disputes are subject to mandatory ICC arbitration seated in Osaka if demanded by Array and New York if demanded by Ono, rather than exclusive jurisdiction in the New York County courts contemplated by the preferred standard.

items.expectedFix: No change is required. Preferably, Ono's affiliate assignments would also be permitted without consent.
items.note: The restriction is mutual, and either party may assign without consent to an acquirer of substantially all relevant business or assets, including through merger or acquisition, upon written assumption. Other affiliate assignments require consent not unreasonably withheld or delayed. This reaches the fallback standard.

items.expectedFix: Give Ono an unrestricted right to exploit, license, assign and enforce its interest in jointly owned IP, or allocate ownership by inventorship with appropriate cross-licences. Narrow termination transfers and grant-backs to Product-specific materials necessary for Array's continued exploitation, preserving Ono's background IP and general know-how.
items.note: Ono owns inventions made solely by its personnel and receives the Product Trademarks, which are favourable. However, jointly created IP is jointly owned while either party is barred from external practice, enforcement, licensing or assignment without the other's consent. Ono also grants Array a broad licence to Ono Improvements and must transfer Regulatory Filings and related Data/Know-How to Array on termination. The restricted joint ownership falls within the playbook's walkaway formulation.

items.expectedFix: No change is required for fallback compliance. Preferably, remove Array's consent right for ordinary contractors and expressly state that all Ono licences transfer to a permitted successor.
items.note: Ono receives exclusive development and commercialization licences, a manufacturing licence covering Affiliates and third-party manufacturers, and a path to sublicense to Affiliates and third parties. Following expiration, the principal licences become fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual and sublicensable. Assignment to an M&A successor is permitted under the assignment clause. The outgoing grant-backs and termination reversion provisions do not negate the compliant scope of Ono's principal licence.

items.expectedFix: Specify at least 15 days' prior written notice, retain the annual frequency and independent confidential auditor, and provide that Array bears the cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
items.note: The financial audit is limited to once per Calendar Year, uses an independent accounting firm reasonably acceptable to Ono, requires confidentiality and occurs at Array's cost unless a redacted underpayment threshold is exceeded. Notice is only described as reasonable, and the redacted threshold prevents confirmation that the clause reaches fallback.

items.expectedFix: Limit inspections to once per 12 months on at least 15 days' written notice during business hours, by an independent representative bound by confidentiality, with Array bearing the cost and no direct access to Ono systems.
items.note: Array has a separate, broad right to enter Ono facilities and inspect internal procedures and records concerning all Product matters. The right has no frequency limit and requires only reasonable advance notice, falling below the audit fallback.

items.expectedFix: No change is required.
items.note: The liquidated-damages remedy is payable by Array to Ono through a reduced royalty rate following specified serious Array misconduct. It benefits Customer; no liquidated damages or penalty payable by Ono is identified.

items.expectedFix: Add an express performance and conformance warranty lasting at least 30 days for services and 90 days for software or supplied deliverables, with repair, replacement or refund remedies, compliance with laws and a no-malicious-code commitment.
items.note: Array gives corporate, title, regulatory and legal-compliance representations, but no ongoing professional-and-workmanlike performance or Product conformance warranty with a defined duration and repair, replacement or refund remedy. The 60-day period in p0610 is only a deadline for trademark-use objections, not a warranty period, and p0711 broadly disclaims unexpressed warranties.

items.expectedFix: Add minimum Array coverage for commercial general liability, professional/E&O, cyber/privacy where applicable, and workers' compensation, with certificates available on request. At minimum require USD 1 million E&O and USD 2 million cyber coverage.
items.note: No insurance provision requires Array to maintain coverage despite its development, clinical-study and supply responsibilities.

items.expectedFix: No change is required.
items.note: The royalty floor limits reductions from royalties otherwise generated by actual Net Sales; it does not require minimum purchases, minimum sales volumes or take-or-pay payments when no sales occur.

items.expectedFix: Add Array obligations, upon expiry or termination, to provide Ono up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return or export Ono data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certify deletion after the transition. At minimum provide 90 days of assistance and a 30-day data export.
items.note: The agreement contains extensive wind-down and transition obligations, but they principally require Ono to continue studies and distribution and transfer Regulatory Filings, Data, know-how, trademarks and domains to Array. The reciprocal cooperation covenant does not require Array to provide transition assistance to Ono, export Ono data within 30 days or certify deletion.
